sqlpipe 2.0

Breaking change: /v2/users no longer returns a name field. The endpoint returns first_name and last_name instead: a request that returned {"name": "Ada Lovelace"} now returns {"first_name": "Ada", "last_name": "Lovelace"}. If your client reads the name field, that lookup breaks on upgrade. Update the client first, or pin it to v1 until you're ready to migrate.

New: the --incremental flag. Pass --incremental and sqlpipe pulls only rows that changed since the last sync, instead of scanning the full table.

Performance: Parquet writes run 40% faster in this release. We rewrote the encoding path to batch column writes instead of flushing row by row.

Check your integration against the new /v2/users response before you deploy.
